prose: From Niish: "Take a break with me as we chat with Chance Garton. If you are feeling down or are needing a break from what appears to be a very dark landscape, this is the chat for you.

Chance and I get into the power of healing through tuning forks, mindful curation of thought and perception bias, and then we move into the ever fascinating realm of language: dead languages and the power of words as they relate to the mutable modern world of communication that includes emojis, slang, and ebonics. We also traverse through some Jungian territory and tie it all together in a deeply dynamic chat. This is a conversation and not an interview.

Chance is extremely intelligent and well rounded in his knowledge and insight as to the journey we are on from his vantage point. I came out of this conversation with more of a desire to dig deeper into the dead languages that are truly the foundation of the reality in which we collectively experience. It's all connected."
